choices.content: The line is parallel to the plane
The line and the plane have only one point of intersection
The line is perpendicular to the plane
The entire line lies in this plane

question.prompt: If two points on a line lie in a plane, what follows?

solutions.explanation: Under the usual reading that “two points” means two distinct points, apply the basic line-plane incidence fact: if two distinct points of a line lie in a plane, the entire line lies in that plane. Therefore the answer is D.
solutions.title: Two-point containment axiom
